name: Teresh
overview: Teresh is a male figure known from the biblical text Esther 2:21. He is noted for his involvement in a conspiracy against King Ahasuerus. There is no record of his tribal affiliation or additional personal details in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Teresh appears as a proper name in the text and is possibly derived from a meaning related to 'desire.' This name was not given by God but is simply recorded in the narrative in Esther 2:21.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Teresh beyond what is mentioned regarding his conspiracy against Ahasuerus. No other relational information is provided.
scriptureSignificance: Teresh holds significance in the biblical narrative as one of the conspirators against King Ahasuerus, highlighting the political intrigue present during Esther's time. His role, though brief, contributes to the unfolding events that demonstrate God's providential protection over His people, even in moments of danger and opposition.
